assets.title: Week 12 opener board with one look and several inspiration thumbnails
assets.description: A single adult-learning board that shows one fashion look or sketch plus several possible inspiration-source thumbnails so students can make quick controlled source selections.
assets.notes: Keep the visible source options distinct and easy to compare on a phone screen. Avoid ambiguous or decorative thumbnails that do not support a clear controlled answer.

assets.title: Week 12 keyed inspiration-source vocabulary board A to H
assets.description: A clear adult-learning board with eight inspiration-source images labeled A to H for explicit image-to-word matching.
assets.notes: Keep the keys literal and visible. Use only source images that clearly support nature, city, street style, music, art, architecture, history, and memory. Make history a clear historical-fashion cue such as an archival illustration, vintage dress form, museum garment display, or historical silhouette board. Make memory a clear personal-memory cue such as a family photo with a fabric swatch, keepsake textile, or memory-box object, and keep both panels visibly distinct from art and architecture.

assets.title: Week 12 keyed mood-and-effect board
assets.description: A controlled four-panel board with stable visible keys and clear design cues for matching a look to one mood and one effect phrase.
assets.notes: Avoid subjective or ambiguous styling. Each panel should make the correct mood and effect obvious through visible color, silhouette, contrast, or line choices.

assets.title: Week 12 reusable inspiration gallery image A to image D
assets.description: A reusable four-panel gallery for reading, listening, writing, and speaking. Each panel should show one look tied to a distinct inspiration source and rationale model.
assets.notes: Keep image A to image D literal and stable. Use one nature or ocean look, one city look, one music look, and one architecture look so the reading, listening, writing, and speaking tasks can align tightly.

assets.title: Week 12 numbered inspiration-and-design listening clip
assets.description: One short A2 listening clip with numbered descriptions aligned exactly to the Week 12 reusable image A to image D gallery.
assets.notes: Keep the listening script only in audio_prompts.json. Do not create a separate transcript asset. The gallery labels, numbered script, question labels, options, and correct answers must match exactly.
